text: plane-dsh-plugin 是面向 DSH Web 的 Plane 项目管理插件：它通过 Cordis host 和浏览器 client 接入工具、会话上下文、后台任务与全局悬浮面板。用户可以发现并绑定 Plane 项目、记录会话中的任务与进展事件、在本地 SQLite Outbox 暂存后异步同步，并在面板查看工作项、调整状态和重试失败批次。适合希望把 DSH 编码工作关联到 Plane 项目并持续跟踪的人。需要配置 Plane workspace、workspaceSlug 和 DSH credentials 中的 PLANE_API_KEY。

plane-dsh-plugin links DSH Web sessions with Plane: bind projects, queue work events locally, sync them in the background, and review items in a floating panel. Configure a Plane workspace and API key.
想把 DSH 会话里完成的任务和进展同步到 Plane 项目。
有没有办法在 DSH 里绑定工作目录和对应的 Plane 项目？
I want to review and update Plane work items from a floating panel in DSH.
plane-dsh-plugin 的功能「项目绑定与事件记录」：Agent 可发现 Plane 项目、查询或绑定工作目录，也能把捕获的工作事件记入本地队列，供后台同步。
plane-dsh-plugin 的功能「全局项目面板」：在 DSH Web 悬浮面板选择已绑定项目、查看摘要与工作项、修改状态，并重试同步失败的批次。

A native [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that quietly turns meaningful coding work into Plane project updates.

plane-dsh-plugin README · plane-dsh-plugin：The plugin recognizes tasks, bugs, decisions, ideas, risks, milestones, plans, progress, and completions during an agent session. It writes events to a local SQLite outbox first, synchronizes them to [Plane](https://plane.so/) asynchronously, and exposes a global floating panel for inspecting and updating work items.

> [!NOTE]
> This project is an early release. The storage and synchronization paths are extensively tested, but DSH and its external plugin APIs are still evolving.

plane-dsh-plugin README · Features：- DSH-native Cordis host and browser client plugin in one installable bundle.
- Eight agent tools for project discovery, binding, capture, and review.
- Durable local SQLite outbox with idempotency, retries, leases, and crash recovery.
- Asynchronous synchronization to Plane without blocking the main agent task.
- Incremental active-item context instead of repeating a full project snapshot every turn.
- Floating Plane-style panel with status filters, optimistic updates, and sync health.
- Manual project switcher for DSH's global overlay, including duplicate-name disambiguation and stale-response protection.
- Plane API keys resolved through DSH credentials and never written to the plugin database.

plane-dsh-plugin README · Requirements：- Node.js 22.19 or newer.
- pnpm available on `PATH` for DSH plugin management.
- A recent `@deepseek-ai/dsh` release with external bundles, credentials, tools, client slots, and Typert remote support.
- A Plane workspace and API key.

plane-dsh-plugin README · Install：Install the prebuilt npm package into DSH's Web profile:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add plane-dsh-plugin
```

The npm package already contains the host and browser bundles. Installation does not build this repository or require an `allowBuilds` exception.

plane-dsh-plugin README · From a local checkout：Use this path only when developing the plugin itself:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Bene-2020/plane-dsh-plugin.git
cd plane-dsh-plugin
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build

plane-dsh-plugin README · Configure：Store the Plane key in DSH credentials, never in `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml

plane-dsh-plugin README · $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml：PLANE_API_KEY: "your-plane-api-key"
```

Then override the bundle row in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` with your workspace slug:

```yaml
- id: plane-dsh-plugin
  config:
    workspaceSlug: your-workspace-slug
    planeBaseUrl: https://api.plane.so
    planeMode: sdk
```

Start DSH with the same profile:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

plane-dsh-plugin README · $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml：The agent will offer Plane project binding when it first encounters an unbound working directory. The panel appears as a floating button in the DSH web UI. See [Configuration](docs/configuration.md) for every option and troubleshooting guidance.

plane-dsh-plugin README · Development：```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test
pnpm run test:coverage
```

`pnpm test` builds the workspace and distributable bundle, validates the packed artifact, and runs the full test suite. Client coverage is held at 100% for statements, branches, functions, and lines.

Useful commands:

plane-dsh-plugin README · Development：| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm build` | Build internal packages and assemble the public bundle. |
| `pnpm test` | Build, verify the package contract, and run tests. |
| `pnpm run test:coverage` | Run the coverage gate. |
| `pnpm run pack:check` | Inspect the publishable tarball contract in a temporary directory. |

plane-dsh-plugin README · Privacy and security：- Source code, terminal output, and full transcripts are not stored by the plugin.
- The Plane API key is resolved per operation through DSH credentials.
- Local project metadata and the outbox are stored in SQLite at `~/.dsh/plugins/ambient-project/ambient.sqlite` by default.
- Before reporting a vulnerability, read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

一个原生的 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件，在不中断 Agent 主任务的前提下，把有项目价值的编码工作同步到 Plane。

插件会识别会话中的任务、Bug、决策、想法、风险、里程碑、计划、进展和完成事件，先可靠写入本地 SQLite Outbox，再异步同步到 [Plane](https://plane.so/)。DSH Web 中还会出现一个全局悬浮面板，用于查看项目状态和更新工作项。

> [!NOTE]
> 当前是早期版本。存储与同步链路已经经过完整测试，但 DSH 的外部插件 API 仍在快速演进。

plane-dsh-plugin README · 主要功能：- 一个安装包同时提供 DSH Cordis host 插件和浏览器 client 插件。
- 8 个用于项目发现、绑定、事件记录和审计的 Agent 工具。
- 带幂等、重试、租约和崩溃恢复能力的本地 SQLite Outbox。
- 后台异步同步 Plane，不阻塞当前 Agent 工作。
- 增量注入活跃工作项，避免每回合重复完整项目快照。
- Plane 风格悬浮面板，支持状态筛选、乐观更新和同步健康展示。
- 面向 DSH 全局悬浮层的手动项目切换器，支持同名项目区分和过期响应隔离。
- Plane API Key 通过 DSH credentials 读取，不写入插件数据库。

plane-dsh-plugin README · 环境要求：- Node.js 22.19 或更高版本。
- `PATH` 中可用的 pnpm，用于 DSH 插件管理。
- 支持外部 bundle、credentials、tools、client slots 和 Typert remote 的较新 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 版本。
- 一个 Plane workspace 和 API Key。

plane-dsh-plugin README · 安装：将预构建的 npm 包安装到 DSH Web profile：

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add plane-dsh-plugin
```

该 npm 包已经包含 host 和浏览器 bundle。安装时不会构建本仓库，也不需要配置 `allowBuilds`。

plane-dsh-plugin README · 从本地源码安装：仅在开发插件本身时使用这种方式：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Bene-2020/plane-dsh-plugin.git
cd plane-dsh-plugin
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build

plane-dsh-plugin README · 配置：把 Plane Key 放入 DSH credentials，不要写进 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml

plane-dsh-plugin README · $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml：PLANE_API_KEY: "your-plane-api-key"
```

然后在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖插件配置，填入自己的 workspace slug：

```yaml
- id: plane-dsh-plugin
  config:
    workspaceSlug: your-workspace-slug
    planeBaseUrl: https://api.plane.so
    planeMode: sdk
```

使用同一个 profile 启动 DSH：

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

当 Agent 首次进入尚未绑定的工作目录时，会询问要关联哪个 Plane 项目。DSH Web 中会出现悬浮按钮。全部配置项和排障方法见[配置文档](docs/configuration.md)。

plane-dsh-plugin README · 隐私与安全：- 插件不保存源码、终端输出或完整对话记录。
- Plane API Key 每次操作时从 DSH credentials 获取。
- 项目元数据和 Outbox 默认保存在 `~/.dsh/plugins/ambient-project/ambient.sqlite`。
- 报告安全问题前请阅读 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。
